acceptanceCriteria: Oversized supported built-in read/bash-style outputs are bounded by per-line and total serialized byte caps, including one-giant-line fixtures.
Oversized unsupported/custom extension tool success outputs get a generic compact envelope instead of returning raw large content/details.
Default compacted tool_result replacement serializes below a 20KB hard budget, with tests that would fail on the existing one-line leak.
Preserve small/normal tool outputs and existing specialized envelopes where appropriate.
planning.tddSlice: One-giant-line read output and oversized unsupported custom tool output are compacted under a 20KB hard serialized budget.
